title: BNPL Platinum: Understanding Your 6-Month Financing Term
summary: Explains BNPL Platinum financing over a 6-month term: the term starts when the financed purchase posts, amortizes via equal monthly installments (principal plus any accrued interest), and keeps a consistent monthly due date unless changed in account settings. Provides a month-by-month timeline (Month 1 through the final month) and guidance that paying more than the minimum reduces outstanding principal and may reduce total interest; later financed purchases create separate schedules to track.
